source: Designer supplied an organizer announcement in the project conversation; announcement date and URL were not supplied.
quote: For the Chipalooza #3 (GF) designers: I did a first draft of a floorplan of the GF180MCU version of the harness chip, and it looks like the user areas are going to be approximately 1270um x 410um. This is the same area as I had previously suggested to some of the designers, but a different aspect ratio. So please keep that in mind when starting layout work and floorplanning your circuit.
scope: Planning target superseding the earlier inferred wrapper dimensions. Not a final wrapper, slot assignment, pin map, or verified integration boundary.
placement_policy: Keep the analog core compact. Use available space selectively for matching, isolation, supply routing and harness access; do not stretch sensitive nets to fill the area.
